question: What is the ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK?
predicted_sql: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 END), 0) AS ratio FROM customers;
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) / SUM(IIF(Currency = 'CZK', 1, 0)) AS ratio FROM customers

question: What are the speed in which attacks are put together of the top 4 teams with the highest build Up Play Speed?
predicted_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT team_api_id, MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS build_up_play_speed FROM Team_Attributes GROUP BY team_api_id) SELECT t.team_long_name, ranked.build_up_play_speed FROM ranked JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = ranked.team_api_id ORDER BY ranked.build_up_play_speed DESC, t.team_long_name LIMIT 4;

question: What is the surname of the driver with the best lap time in race number 19 in the second qualifying period?
predicted_sql: SELECT d.surname FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 19 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 <> '' ORDER BY CASE WHEN instr(q.q2, ':') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1) AS REAL) ELSE CAST(q.q2 AS REAL) END ASC LIMIT 1
gold_sql: SELECT T2.surname FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 19 ORDER BY T1.q2 ASC LIMIT 1

question: Rank superheroes from Marvel Comics by their eye color popularity, starting with the most common color.
predicted_sql: SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour, COUNT(*) AS popularity FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' GROUP BY c.colour ORDER BY popularity DESC, c.colour ASC;
gold_sql: SELECT colour.colour AS EyeColor, COUNT(superhero.id) AS Count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(superhero.id) DESC) AS PopularityRank FROM superhero INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' GROUP BY colour.colour

question: Calculate the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules.
predicted_sql: SELECT AVG(a.element = 'o') AS average_oxygen_atoms FROM atom AS a WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-') ;
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) FROM (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.element) AS oxygen_count FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id  WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.element = 'o'  GROUP BY T1.molecule_id) AS oxygen_counts

question: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers.
predicted_sql: SELECT CharterNum, avg_writing_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_writing_score DESC) AS school_rank FROM (SELECT s.CharterNum, AVG(sc.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score FROM schools AS s JOIN satscores AS sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds WHERE s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.CharterNum HAVING AVG(sc.AvgScrWrite) > 499) AS ranked ORDER BY avg_writing_score DESC;
gold_sql: SELECT CharterNum, AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools AS T1  INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND CharterNum is not null

question: List out the no. of districts that have female average salary is more than 6000 but less than 10000?
